name: geonames
label: GeoNames (Geographic Database)
description: World geographic database — 11M+ place names, admin divisions, postal codes with coordinates
short_description: World geographic database — 11M+ place names, admin divisions, postal codes with coordinates
long_description: GeoNames is the world's largest geographic database with over 11 million place names (cities, mountains, rivers, airports, landmarks) covering every country. Includes administrative division hierarchies (states/provinces/counties), postal codes for 100+ countries, alternate name translations in hundreds of languages, and elevation data. Freely available under Creative Commons CC-BY 4.0.
when_to_use: Use for any application needing geographic lookups, address validation, timezone resolution, or administrative boundary data. Essential for country/region/city dropdowns, geosearch, and location data normalization. Load data via: flask forge templates install-data geonames (auto-downloads from geonames.org — ~1.5GB uncompressed, CC-BY 4.0 license, no registration required).

table_notes.geonames_feature: Core table with all 11M+ geographic features. Index on country_code + feature_class for efficient filtering. The search_vector column enables full-text search across all names.
table_notes.geonames_altname: Alternative names and translations for each feature. Covers 1000+ languages and scripts plus ISO 3166 codes, IATA codes, and Wikipedia links.
table_notes.geonames_country: Country-level metadata including ISO codes, FIPS, population, area, capital, languages, and continent. One row per country/territory.
table_notes.geonames_admin1: First-level administrative divisions (states, provinces, regions). 3,900+ entries worldwide. Hierarchical code matches geonames_feature.admin1_code.
table_notes.geonames_admin2: Second-level administrative divisions (counties, districts, departments). 45,000+ entries. Hierarchical code matches geonames_feature.admin2_code.
table_notes.geonames_postal_code: 15M+ postal codes with geographic coordinates. Essential for postcode-to-location lookups and delivery zone queries. Add unique index: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON geonames_postal_code(country_code, postal_code, place_name) for idempotent loads.
table_notes.geonames_feature_code: Reference table of all 645 GeoNames feature class/code combinations (e.g. P/PPL = populated place, T/MT = mountain).
table_notes.geonames_timezone: Timezone definitions referenced by geographic features. Includes UTC offsets for current time and DST calculations.

geonames_feature.name: geonameid
geonames_feature.description: GeoNames unique identifier (stable across versions)

geonames_feature.name: name
geonames_feature.description: Toponym name in UTF-8 encoding

geonames_feature.name: asciiname
geonames_feature.description: Name in plain ASCII (for legacy systems)

geonames_feature.name: alternatenames
geonames_feature.description: Comma-separated alternate names (short form — full data in geonames_altname)

geonames_feature.name: latitude
geonames_feature.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees

geonames_feature.name: longitude
geonames_feature.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees

geonames_feature.name: geo_point
geonames_feature.description: PostGIS point geometry (computed from lat/lng). Enables ST_DWithin, ST_Distance queries.

geonames_feature.name: feature_class
geonames_feature.description: Feature class: A=admin, H=water, L=area, P=place, R=road, S=spot, T=terrain, U=ocean, V=vegetation

geonames_feature.name: feature_code
geonames_feature.description: Feature code (e.g. PPL=populated place, PPLC=capital, ADM1=admin div 1). See geonames_feature_code.

geonames_feature.name: country_code
geonames_feature.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

geonames_feature.name: cc2
geonames_feature.description: Alternate country codes (comma-separated) for disputed territories

geonames_feature.name: admin1_code
geonames_feature.description: First-level admin division code (state/province). Matches geonames_admin1.code.

geonames_feature.name: admin2_code
geonames_feature.description: Second-level admin division code (county/district). Matches geonames_admin2.code.

geonames_feature.name: admin3_code
geonames_feature.description: Third-level admin division code (municipality)

geonames_feature.name: admin4_code
geonames_feature.description: Fourth-level admin division code

geonames_feature.name: population
geonames_feature.description: Population count (approximate, from various sources). NULL for non-populated features.

geonames_feature.name: elevation
geonames_feature.description: Elevation in metres above sea level (from SRTM/ASTER data)

geonames_feature.name: dem
geonames_feature.description: Digital Elevation Model (SRTM3 or GTOPO30)

geonames_feature.name: timezone
geonames_feature.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/Berlin)

geonames_feature.name: modification_date
geonames_feature.description: Date this record was last updated in GeoNames database

geonames_feature.name: search_vector
geonames_feature.description: PostgreSQL full-text search vector over name + asciiname for fast text search

geonames_altname.name: isolanguage
geonames_altname.description: ISO 639 language code, or: link, abbr, iata, icao, fr_1793, historic, wkdt (Wikidata), wiki, post, phone, unlc

geonames_altname.name: alternate_name
geonames_altname.description: Alternate name in the specified language/script or code value

geonames_altname.name: is_preferred_name
geonames_altname.description: True if this is the preferred name in this language (most human-readable)

geonames_altname.name: is_short_name
geonames_altname.description: True if this is the short/abbreviated form of the name

geonames_altname.name: is_colloquial
geonames_altname.description: True if this is a colloquial or informal name

geonames_altname.name: is_historic
geonames_altname.description: True if this was historically used but is now obsolete

geonames_altname.name: from_date
geonames_altname.description: Date from which this name was/is valid

geonames_altname.description: Date until which this name was valid (NULL = still valid)

geonames_country.name: fips_code

geonames_country.name: continent

geonames_country.name: phone_prefix

geonames_country.name: postal_code_format
